what_happened: Launched deploy-headless.sh in the background and continued editing Phase 4's source files (runtime-file-patterns.sh, the standards doc) before it finished. The deployed tree captured a partial edit state, causing test-runtime-file-tracking.sh (which resolves .claude/ before the source store) to see a stale 20-member lib paired with a stale standards doc and fail Case 5. Also surfaced an unrelated pre-existing specs/TODO.md sync drift from task 329's own earlier IMPLEMENTING status transition not yet regenerated into TODO.md.

scripts/tests/test-orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh has 14 pre-existing failures (Group 28/Arm B-D) unrelated to this task, caused by a missing generate-task-order.sh in the test fixture's scratch .claude/scripts/ copy (ERROR: generate-task-order.sh failed with exit code 127). Confirmed pre-existing by re-running the identical suite against the unmodified git-HEAD copy of orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh (same 335 passed/14 failed split), so this task's Phase 6 edits are not the cause. Not fixed here -- out of this task's scope -- but recorded so a future reader does not misattribute it.
